name: The letter of introduction
note: Doc 23, and the only Act I inventory item with a ruling 19a state change. Both states carry a full line set; the gate is T_PIKE_DEAD. Doc 23 note 1: the after-state's third LOOK is the one moment in the act where Thad is not being funny, and a joke must not be added to it. Two rules over one item rather than two items, because the letter's semantic identity does not change -- what changed is the world. Ruling 19a's two-hotspots pattern is for when the NAME changes too, which is the coach.

LOOK_AT.say: A letter of introduction to a man who has been dead six years. I have not opened it.
repeat: Still sealed. It seems rude, somehow, and I am not certain to whom.
My father did not know. That is the part I keep arriving at.

LOOK_AT.say: A letter of introduction to Mr Ezra Pike of Consolation, in my father’s hand, sealed.
repeat: My father wrote it in one sitting and would not let me read it.
Sealed. I have carried it eleven hundred miles without opening it, which I had thought was patience.
Nothing. Whatever it says, it is saying it to nobody.
